published_prior_art.cite: ChenSantAnnaXie2025 gives complete-panel observable PT-All moments; BellegoBenatiaDortetBernadet2025 gives supported-link moments for incomplete panels, not this arbitrary-pattern null-space completeness.
BellegoBenatiaDortetBernadet2025 supplies ΔATT=WATT and optimal GMM, but does not eliminate treated/ATT coordinates to characterize its span inside all observable PT-All restrictions.
BellegoBenatiaDortetBernadet2025 optimizes its link stack and ChenSantAnnaXie2025 derives a complete-panel EIF; neither supplies the structural-pattern quotient Schur-complement criterion.
No verified cited paper gives this seven-cell rotating support, zero Bellégo link span, and 16-to-40/3 target-variance calculation.

TestaKennedyReimherr2025 v1 proves observed-data EIFs only in a two-group, two-period MAR design; ChenSantAnnaXie2025 treats complete short panels; neither settles arbitrary nonmonotone pattern tangent exhaustion.

Generic DML gives cross-fitting machinery, while Bellégo uses parametric propensity first steps and TestaKennedyReimherr2025 treats two periods; the quotient-efficient rotating-panel construction remains new conditional on the OEQ.

CallawaySantAnna2021 and ChernozhukovChetverikovKato2017 already provide the relevant finite-dimensional multiplier-inference machinery; novelty is inherited from the quotient score and derived-rank setting.
ChenSantAnnaXie2025 Lemma 2.1, Lemma 3.2, and Theorem 3.2 are the stated complete-panel benchmarks.
ChenHongTarozzi2008 supplies the general inverse-inclusion template; the CBS-specific correspondence and insufficiency audit are an application-level specialization.

soundness_flags.label: ass:fixed-loading-independence
soundness_flags.one_line: C_Q is constructed as pivot columns complementary to the full-column-rank basis B, so L_full=[B,C_Q] is already full column rank and its positive minimum singular value exists for every fixed declared design; this must be a derived design lemma, not an assumption.

soundness_flags.label: prop:complete-panel-reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: Q=0 implies only equality of the proposed restriction-span projection with its Bellégo-span projection, not exact equality of the proposed cross-fitted one-step procedure with Bellégo's optimal GMM, whose paper retains a distinct parametric first-step setup and explicitly notes its remaining first-step efficiency loss.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: oeq:canonical-gradient and conditional conclusions in thm:one-step-attainment and thm:multiplier-bands
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Full observed-data tangent-space exhaustion, hence the claim that phi_eff,k is the canonical gradient and V_k the Hájek--Le Cam bound, is assumed through an affirmative resolution of the OEQ.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The estimator-attainment and efficiency-band headlines are accepted only conditionally: if the pattern-score adjoint establishes full tangent-space exhaustion, then the stated quotient-projected estimator attains V_k on M_rot.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace ass:fixed-loading-independence with an exact-elimination lemma that computes s_L from the declared support, and state the inference subclass using only positive quotient dimension plus primitive score nondegeneracy.

Repair the complete-panel reduction by distinguishing equality of restriction spaces and projected influence functions from equality with Bellégo's implemented GMM; give exact additional conditions if an estimator-level equality is intended.

Resolve the pattern-score adjoint OEQ on a nontrivial generic class of nonmonotone supports, so that the canonical-gradient and efficiency-attainment claims become unconditional rather than conditional.
